title: Membership Tenure in Summit Requalification
content:
When the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program sets a member's tier from the counted qualifying dollars of the calendar year, the membership's tenure decides how its posted qualifying dollars count.

**Clause.** Tenure is the whole years since the membership's enrolment date, a year being complete on the anniversary of that date.

1. A membership enrolled 10 or more whole years ago counts the greater of: its posted qualifying dollars multiplied by 1.1 and rounded down to the whole dollar; and its posted qualifying dollars plus a flat 250 USD.
2. A membership enrolled 5 to fewer than 10 whole years ago counts its posted qualifying dollars with a flat 200 USD added, with no multiplying.
3. A younger membership counts its posted qualifying dollars as posted.

The posted qualifying dollars are the qualifying dollars of the calendar year as the membership's qualifying-dollar total shows them.

### Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Posted qualifying dollars (USD) | Whole years since enrolment | Multiplied by 1.1, rounded down | Plus 250 | Counted after tenure (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8200.50 | 12 | 9020 | 8450.50 | 9020 |
| 2000.00 | 12 | 2200 | 2250.00 | 2250.00 |
| 8200.50 | 7 | not used | not used | 8400.50 (plus 200) |
| 8200.50 | 4 | not used | not used | 8200.50 |

### Anniversary boundary (hypothetical)

A membership enrolled on 20 April 2016 has 9 whole years on 19 April 2026 and 10 whole years on 20 April 2026.
